m1_limitations.title: Hard-locked single dispatch attempt & no build_attempts starvation check
m1_limitations.summary: M1 binding.plan_checks locks policy.max_attempts_per_node == 1 and only checks time_s / model_calls / memory_mb against admission caps, ignoring retry budgets and build_attempts == 0 starvation (while hurting transient-failure Class A delivery).

m1_limitations.title: No concurrent resource/checkout mutex or reachable-state model
m1_limitations.summary: M1 validates local node fields statically and models neither exclusive workspace/builder locks nor concurrent interleavings across active nodes.

m1_limitations.title: Checks predecessor DAG acyclicity only, missing scheduler depends_on cycles
m1_limitations.summary: M1 kahn_order() inspects node.predecessors only and has no factory.plan/1 depends_on field, letting scheduling-layer ordering deadlocks pass.

m1_limitations.title: Coarse effect_class only, lacking per-kind write-prohibition & join rules
m1_limitations.summary: M1 checks coarse effect_class membership and capability layout rules without per-kind build/deliver workspace != write least-privilege guards or join_before_build.

------------------------------- MODULE Graph -------------------------------
(***************************************************************************)
(* Self-contained deliverable TaskGraph and execution specification.       *)
(* Standalone TLC check:                                                   *)
(*   java -cp tla2tools.jar tlc2.TLC -config safety.cfg Graph.tla          *)
(* Zero-JVM Python parser: ``tla_graph.parse_taskgraph_tla``               *)
(***************************************************************************)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences, TLC

CONSTANT Cooperative

\* -- 1. Execution topology and contract constants -------------------------
TaskId == "muse-q2-ttft-v2"
Objective == "Starting from stock llama.cpp 9048bad8 and the official Muse Spark Open NVFP4 checkpoint, build an optimized single candidate delivering NVFP4 ingestion, expert scale wiring, Q2_K weight pack compilation, and the seeded expert weight cache on a single DGX Spark GB10."
PlannerName == "factory.ai_planner"
AllowedEffects == {"process.exec", "workspace.read", "workspace.write"}

Nodes == {"build_candidate", "build_compiler", "combine", "deliver_to_lab", "inspect_engine", "integrate_cache", "integrate_reader", "integrate_wiring", "preflight_cache"}
Deliver == "deliver_to_lab"
MaxParallel == 4

Preds == (
    "inspect_engine" :> {}
 @@
    "preflight_cache" :> {"inspect_engine"}
 @@
    "integrate_reader" :> {"inspect_engine"}
 @@
    "integrate_wiring" :> {"inspect_engine"}
 @@
    "integrate_cache" :> {"preflight_cache"}
 @@
    "build_compiler" :> {"inspect_engine", "integrate_reader"}
 @@
    "combine" :> {"integrate_cache", "integrate_reader", "integrate_wiring"}
 @@
    "build_candidate" :> {"build_compiler", "combine"}
 @@
    "deliver_to_lab" :> {"build_candidate"}
)

Limit == (
    "inspect_engine" :> 2
 @@
    "preflight_cache" :> 2
 @@
    "integrate_reader" :> 2
 @@
    "integrate_wiring" :> 2
 @@
    "integrate_cache" :> 2
 @@
    "build_compiler" :> 3
 @@
    "combine" :> 2
 @@
    "build_candidate" :> 3
 @@
    "deliver_to_lab" :> 2
)

Exclusive == (
    "inspect_engine" :> {}
 @@
    "preflight_cache" :> {}
 @@
    "integrate_reader" :> {"checkout"}
 @@
    "integrate_wiring" :> {"checkout"}
 @@
    "integrate_cache" :> {"checkout"}
 @@
    "build_compiler" :> {"builder"}
 @@
    "combine" :> {"checkout"}
 @@
    "build_candidate" :> {"builder"}
 @@
    "deliver_to_lab" :> {}
)

\* -- 3. Static contract & safety assertions verified by TLC on load -------
ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

=============================================================================

       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]

       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

=============================================================================

\* -- 3. Static contract & safety assertions verified by TLC on load -------
ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

=============================================================================

ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

=============================================================================

               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]

\* -- 3. Static contract & safety assertions verified by TLC on load -------
ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes

       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN

       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

\* -- 3. Static contract & safety assertions verified by TLC on load -------
ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars

=============================================================================

\* -- 3. Static contract & safety assertions verified by TLC on load -------
ASSUME /\ Deliver \in Nodes
       /\ Preds \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
       /\ Limit \in [Nodes -> Nat]
       /\ MaxParallel \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Cooperative \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(\E m \in Nodes : Deliver \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : n = Deliver \/ (\E m \in Nodes : n \in Preds[m])
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : NodeSpec[n].authority.effects \subseteq AllowedEffects
       /\ \A n \in Nodes :
            (\E i \in 1..Len(NodeSpec[n].outputs) : NodeSpec[n].outputs[i].kind = "diff")
              => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") <=> (n = Deliver)
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind = "deliver") => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "none"
       /\ \A n \in Nodes : (NodeSpec[n].kind \in {"inspect", "investigate", "build", "measure"}) => NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace # "write"

\* -- 4. Inlined execution state machine & temporal properties -------------
VARIABLES st, att
vars == <<st, att>>

Phases == {"waiting", "active", "done", "failed"}
Active == {n \in Nodes : st[n] = "active"}
Held == UNION {Exclusive[n] : n \in Active}

Init == /\ st = [n \in Nodes |-> "waiting"]
        /\ att = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

CanStart(n) == /\ st[n] = "waiting"
               /\ \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"
               /\ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ Cardinality(Active) < MaxParallel
               /\ Exclusive[n] \cap Held = {}

Start(n) == /\ CanStart(n)
            /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
            /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]

Succeed(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
              /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = "done"]
              /\ UNCHANGED att

SendBack(n) == /\ st[n] = "active"
               /\ ~Cooperative \/ att[n] < Limit[n]
               /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![n] = IF att[n] < Limit[n] THEN "waiting" ELSE "failed"]
               /\ UNCHANGED att

Step == \E n \in Nodes : Start(n) \/ Succeed(n) \/ SendBack(n)

Delivered == st[Deliver] = "done"
Failed == \E n \in Nodes : st[n] = "failed"
CanStep == Active # {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : CanStart(n)
Halt == ~CanStep /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Step \/ Halt
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PhaseWeight(p) == CASE p = "waiting" -> 1 [] p = "active" -> 2 [] OTHER -> 0
RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(f, S \ {x})
Rank == SumOver([n \in Nodes |-> 2 * (Limit[n] - att[n]) + PhaseWeight(st[n])], Nodes)

TypeOK == /\ st \in [Nodes -> Phases]
          /\ att \in [Nodes -> Nat]

DependencyOrder == \A n \in Nodes :
    st[n] \in {"active", "done"} => \A p \in Preds[n] : st[p] = "done"

ExclusiveResources == \A m, n \in Active : m # n =>
    LET rm == Exclusive[m] \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[m].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
        rn == Exclusive[n] \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].authority.workspace = "write" THEN {"checkout"} ELSE {}) \cup (IF NodeSpec[n].kind = "build" THEN {"builder"} ELSE {})
    IN rm \cap rn = {}

ParallelBound == Cardinality(Active) <= MaxParallel

AttemptBound == \A n \in Nodes : att[n] <= Limit[n]

NoStuck == ~CanStep => (Delivered \/ Failed)

DeliveredMeansAllDone == Delivered => \A n \in Nodes : st[n] = "done"

HaltsDelivered == ~CanStep => Delivered

Termination == [][Rank' < Rank]_vars
